P(X=1) = (only fair A heads) + (only fair B heads) + (only biased heads)
= 3/28 + 3/28 + 4/28 = 10/28.

P(X=2) = (biased heads and exactly one fair head) + (biased tails and both fair heads)
= 2*(1/4)*(4/7) + (1/4)*(3/7) = 8/28 + 3/28 = 11/28.

P(X=3) = (1/4)*(4/7) = 4/28.

Thus the desired probability is
\[
\left(\frac{3}{28}\right)^2+\left(\frac{10}{28}\right)^2+\left(\frac{11}{28}\right)^2+\left(\frac{4}{28}\right)^2
=\frac{246}{784}=\frac{123}{392}.
\]
So \(m+n=123+392=\boxed{515}\).
